# OpenDLSS-NR (third-party, vendored GLSL route)

The GLSL cooperative-matrix route of [OpenDLSS-NR](https://github.com/maanHimself/OpenDLSS-NR) at commit `9d08f41`
(MIT, see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`), which flutter_filament runs as an external post pass when an application opts in
and the user supplies model weights (`lib/src/opendlss_nr.dart`). No weights or NVIDIA files are here.

## Why vendored (and not fetched at build time)

- The upstream repository is a single-author, single-drop project (four commits on one day); a build-time fetch would
  break offline and CI builds and depend on it staying online.
- Lumina needs a modified subset: the PTX / CUDA route (`VK_NV_cuda_kernel_launch`) is left out, and the host code
  records into Filament's command buffer instead of owning a device. A fetch would still have to patch.
- The subset is small (about 5 000 lines), MIT, and was reviewed once when it was taken.

## Layout

| path | content | changed by Lumina |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `upstream/shaders/` | `common.glsl`, `attention_common.glsl`, `publish.glsl` and the twelve GLSL kernels the graph dispatches | no (byte-identical) |
| `upstream/src/` | `nr_model.h/.cpp` (manifest + weight re-layout), `json.h`, `numeric.h`, `sha256.h` | no (byte-identical) |
| `upstream/NOTICE` | the upstream notice | no |
| `modified/` | `kernels.h/.cpp`, `nr_graph.h/.cpp` | yes: GLSL route only (see each file's header comment) |

Lumina's own code around it lives in `src/opendlss_nr/` (Apache-2.0, flutter_filament's licence):

- `vk_context.*`: the `vk::Context` the vendored files expect, over bluevk on Filament's device; uploads are
  recorded into the frame's command buffer, objects are released behind a `VkEvent`.
- `model_check.*`: the model folder validator (layout from the graph's own `FusedLayout` functions) and the
  synthetic model writer for tests.
- `capability.*`: the device features the kernels need and the capability check.
- `neural_pass.*`, `shaders/nr_features.comp`, `shaders/nr_composite.comp`: the frame around the network (derived
  from the upstream demo's `nr_preprocess.comp` / `nr_composite.comp`, MIT, with the attribution in their headers).
- `network_*.cpp`: compile the vendored sources on the platforms the pass runs on.
- `spirv.h`: generated by `tool/build_opendlss_nr_shaders.dart` (glslang 16.6+, `--target-env vulkan1.3`).

## Updating

Copy the files of a new upstream commit into `upstream/` unchanged, re-apply the `modified/` changes (remove the
PTX branches, the counter chaining and the captures; keep every GLSL dispatch), update the commit in `NOTICE`,
this file and `OpenDlssNr.upstreamCommit`, run `dart tool/build_opendlss_nr_shaders.dart` and
`flutter test test/src/opendlss_nr_test.dart`.
